transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm visiting today because for the past three days, I've been feeling incredibly jumpy and easily startled by almost everything. Even small sounds or sudden movements make my heart race, and I just can't seem to calm down afterward. It's been happening constantly and I'm really struggling to cope with it.
I'm so sorry you're experiencing this. Did a specific stressful, frightening, or traumatic event happen recently that triggered these feelings?

Yes, something really terrible happened to me exactly three days ago. But honestly, I am doing everything I can to avoid thinking about it or talking about it because it's just too painful to recall. I would really prefer not to go into any of the details of what happened.
I completely respect your wish not to share the details. Since that event, have you been experiencing unwanted memories, nightmares, or sudden feelings as if you are re-living it?
I haven't really had any nightmares or flashbacks since it happened. Honestly, I'm not entirely sure, because I am mostly just trying my best not to think about the event at all.
Since the event, have you felt emotionally numb, detached from your surroundings, or as if you are in a daze?
No, I haven't really experienced feeling emotionally numb or detached from my surroundings. I don't feel like I've been in a daze either.
Since the event occurred, have you had any trouble sleeping, or have you found it difficult to concentrate on daily tasks?
I haven't really noticed any major issues with my sleep over the last few days. I'm also not entirely sure about my concentration, but I think I've been doing okay with focusing on my daily tasks.
Besides avoiding thinking about it, have you been actively avoiding certain places, people, or activities that might remind you of the event?

Yes, I've been desperately avoiding certain places and even some of my friends because they remind me too much of what happened. I've completely changed my route and stopped doing my usual activities just to make sure I don't run into anything that triggers those awful memories.

Yes, I have been feeling constantly on edge and incredibly jumpy since it happened. I startle terribly at sudden noises, unexpected touches, or even quick movements around me. Afterwards, my heart pounds and I tremble for a long time, and I find it really hard to calm back down.
Since the event, have you found it difficult to feel positive emotions, like happiness, love, or excitement, even when doing things you used to enjoy?
I haven't really noticed any difficulty with feeling positive emotions. I'm not entirely sure, but I think I've been feeling okay in that regard.
Since the event, have you noticed yourself being more irritable than usual, or having any sudden outbursts of anger?
No, I haven't really noticed being more irritable or having any sudden outbursts of anger since the event. I think my temper has been pretty much the same as usual.
